unit.why: A short anecdote: R. Moshe Leib of Sassov gives away all his money as charity to a wicked man and, when his followers question him, explains why.

stories.start_quote: בס׳ המאור הגדול כתב בשם הה״ק
stories.end_quote: ויתן לי ג״כ הגם שאני לא טוב
stories.summary_en: R. Moshe Leib of Sassov gave all his money to a man of bad conduct, and when his followers asked why, he said that he too was not good and hoped God would repay him measure for measure.

quotes: פיזר צדקה לאיש א׳ רע מעללים
ואם אני נותן צדקה לאיש אשר לא טוב
